welle_k7.zusage.text: The {partei} group votes for {worum}; in return the government meets its demand: {forderung}.
welle_k7.zusage.worum.einsatz: the mandate for the operation against {land}
welle_k7.zusage.worum.vollmacht: the extension of the Syria and Iraq mandate
welle_k7.mobil.reservisten: Calls up {n} reservists: {anteil}% of the labour force is missing from workplaces, and growth falls by {wachstum} points while they serve.
welle_k7.h.sperre: The Assembly rejected the mandate. A new motion is possible on {datum, date, lang} at the earliest.
welle_k7.h.beschluss.hinweis: Vote in {tage} days. Expected: {ja} in favour, {noetig} needed ({anwesend} present, Art. 96). If the motion fails, a new one is barred for 90 days.
welle_k7.h.kritik.hinweis: Arrests over online posts, investigations into deputies: war weariness counts only half for {wochen} weeks. Press freedom {presse}, minorities {minderheiten}, EU relations {eu}, polarisation {polarisierung}.
welle_k7.h.zusage.hinweis: {partei} votes in favour if the government meets its demand: {forderung}. Brings about {stimmen} votes. Deadline {tage} days; breaking it costs like any broken commitment.
welle_k7.x.zusage: The {partei} group pledges its votes for the mandate. The government promises: {forderung}.
welle_k7.x.zusage.warum: Now expected: {ja} in favour, {noetig} needed. The commitment runs for {tage} days.
welle_k7.x.beschluss.warum: The groups announce their positions: {haltung}. Expected: {ja} in favour, {noetig} needed.
welle_k7.chronik.antrag: Mandate for an operation against {land} submitted
welle_k7.x.kritik: Police detain critics of the operation against {land}; deputies are under investigation.
welle_k7.x.kritik.warum: Until {datum, date, lang}, war weariness counts only half. Press freedom, minorities and EU relations pay the price.
welle_k7.bes.ja: The Assembly grants the mandate for the operation against {land} ({ja} in favour, {nein} against, {enth} abstentions).
welle_k7.bes.nein: The Assembly rejects the mandate for the operation against {land}: {ja} in favour, {noetig} needed ({nein} against, {enth} abstentions).
welle_k7.bes.nein.warum: {haltung}. The government looks weakened; a new motion is possible only from {datum, date, lang}.
welle_k7.chronik.nein: Mandate against {land} fails: {ja} in favour, {noetig} needed
welle_k7.nein.text1: {ja} deputies voted in favour; {noetig} were needed. {nein} voted against and {enth} abstained.
welle_k7.nein.text2: A new motion is possible on {datum, date, lang} at the earliest. Approval {zustimmung}, trust in government {vertrauen}; markets grow nervous.
welle_k7.v.titel: The Syria and Iraq mandate is expiring
welle_k7.v.text1: Without an extension, every operation in Syria and Iraq again needs its own mandate from the Grand National Assembly.
welle_k7.v.text1b: The current mandate ends on {bis, date, lang}.
welle_k7.v.text2.letzte: Last extended on {datum, date, lang}, {ja} votes to {nein}.
welle_k7.v.text2.start: The Assembly has extended it every time since 2014, most recently in 2025 for three years. The CHP and DEM voted against.
welle_k7.v.warum: Article 92 of the Constitution: the Grand National Assembly authorises deployment of the armed forces abroad. The mandate leaves scope, place and timing to the president.
welle_k7.v.opt.jahre_3.label: Extend for three years
welle_k7.v.opt.jahre_3.beschr: As in 2025: a long gap before the next vote, but the centre dislikes the length.
welle_k7.v.opt.jahre_1.label: Extend for one year
welle_k7.v.opt.jahre_1.beschr: As until 2020: the centre is more likely to back it, and the Assembly votes again next October.
welle_k7.v.erwartet: Expected {ja} in favour, {nein} against, {enth} abstentions; {noetig} needed (± {band})
welle_k7.v.warnung: About {fehlen} votes are missing. If the motion fails, the mandate lapses and a new motion is barred for 90 days.
welle_k7.v.opt.zusage.label: Three years, with a commitment to {partei}
welle_k7.v.opt.zusage.beschr: {partei} votes in favour if the government meets its demand: {forderung}. Deadline {tage} days.
welle_k7.v.opt.auslaufen.label: Let it lapse
welle_k7.v.opt.auslaufen.beschr: No motion. Any operation in Syria or Iraq will then need its own mandate.
welle_k7.v.chronik.ja: Syria and Iraq mandate extended: {ja} to {nein}
welle_k7.v.chronik.nein: Syria and Iraq mandate fails: {ja} in favour, {noetig} needed
welle_k7.v.aus.ja: The Assembly extends the mandate by {jahre, plural, one {one year} other {# years}} until {bis, date, lang} ({ja} in favour, {nein} against, {enth} abstentions; {haltung}).
welle_k7.v.aus.nein: The Assembly rejects the extension: {ja} in favour, {noetig} needed ({nein} against, {enth} abstentions; {haltung}). The mandate ends on {bis, date, lang}; a new motion is possible only from {datum, date, lang}.
welle_k7.v.aus.auslaufen: The government does not seek an extension. The mandate ends on {bis, date, lang}.
welle_k7.v.aus.liegen: No motion reached the floor. The mandate ends on {bis, date, lang}.
welle_k7.v.titel_routine: Syria and Iraq mandate: plenary vote
welle_k7.v.text3: Without an answer, the government submits what is planned: {plan}.
welle_k7.m.v.plan_hinweis: The government submits the plan on 21 October. If the majority is shaky or a conflict with Syria or Iraq is running, the decision comes to your desk first.
welle_k7.m.titel: Mandate of the Grand National Assembly
welle_k7.m.reicht: Passes with a margin of about {puffer} votes.
welle_k7.m.vollmacht: Syria and Iraq mandate until {bis, date, lang}: no new vote.
welle_k7.m.v.satz: No new vote needed: the president decides scope, place and timing.
welle_k7.m.vollmacht_frist: Vote on the extension in October {jahr}.
welle_k7.m.sperre: Barred until {datum, date, lang} after the failed motion.
welle_k7.heimat.kritik: Criticism suppressed until {datum, date, lang}: war weariness counts only half.
